title: Run prompt
text: Trim and lock before asynchronous work.
explanation: Root-provided Angular signal state preserves prompt, mode, results and timeline across all five lesson sections.

title: POST to .NET gateway
text: Send JSON to the browser-facing gateway.
explanation: Angular uses the public same-origin /api routes. Development proxies to .NET and production .NET serves Angular. Neither server credential enters the browser.

title: Validate public request
text: Check origin, media, actual bytes and prompt.
explanation: ASP.NET Core bounds actual input32KiB, validates trimmed1–4000 UTF-16 units and does not echo invalid values. Forwarded HTTPS is trusted only through explicit controlled-proxy configuration.

title: Authenticate private handoff
text: Attach the configured token to a fixed upstream route.
explanation: Only the gateway adds its own internal service token. Browser cookies, origin, authorization and supplied internal tokens are not forwarded. Python compares credentials with a timing-safe function.

title: Start real SDK runtime
text: Construct isolated options for the real Python SDK.
explanation: Fresh temporary work/home/config directories, disabled tools/settings/skills/MCP/plugins/session persistence and a scrubbed child environment keep ambient settings out of each run. This is not OS/network sandboxing.
code:
def agent_options(self, base: Path | None = None) -> ClaudeAgentOptions:
    # tools=[] removes built-ins; allowed_tools=[] alone is not a tool ban.
    return ClaudeAgentOptions(
        cwd=str(base / 'work') if base else None,
        extra_args={'no-session-persistence': None},
        tools=[], allowed_tools=[], permission_mode='dontAsk',
        setting_sources=[], skills=[], plugins=[], mcp_servers={}, strict_mcp_config=True,
        max_turns=self.settings.agent_max_turns,
        model=self.settings.claude_model or None,
        system_prompt=self.settings.agent_system_prompt or None,
        env={**{key: '' for key in os.environ if key == 'AGENT_SERVICE_TOKEN' or (key.startswith(('ECS_', 'AWS_', 'GOOGLE_', 'GCLOUD_', 'CLOUDSDK_', 'ANTHROPIC_', 'CLAUDE_')) and key != 'CLAUDE_CODE_GIT_BASH_PATH')},
             **({'HOME': str(base / 'home'), 'USERPROFILE': str(base / 'home'), 'CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR': str(base / 'config')} if base else {}),
             'ANTHROPIC_API_KEY': self.settings.anthropic_api_key.get_secret_value().strip(),
             'ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL': 'https://api.anthropic.com',
             'ENABLE_CLAUDEAI_MCP_SERVERS': 'false', 'CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_AUTO_MEMORY': '1'},
    )

def redact(self, text: str) -> str:
    key = self.settings.anthropic_api_key.get_secret_value().strip()
    return text.replace(key, '[redacted]') if key else text

title: Exchange messages with Claude
explanation: The CLI-backed Python SDK owns provider HTTPS. This excerpt shows the application boundary rather than invented provider transport code.

title: Project safe SDK message
text: Select public lifecycle and text fields.
explanation: Private thinking, paths, session IDs and tool payloads are omitted and key occurrences redacted. SDK messages are not guaranteed token deltas.

title: Emit Python SSE response
text: Use the FastAPI SSE response lifecycle.
explanation: The private response emits safe message/error/done events with heartbeat support. Disconnect cancellation closes the async generator and owned SDK work. Python bounds execution to180 seconds.

title: Flush chunks through .NET
explanation: The gateway flushes every received chunk rather than buffering an answer. A linked185-second token cancels on browser disconnect and closes the private upstream connection.

title: Normalize final result
text: Preserve answer, metrics and failure semantics.
explanation: A non-success SDK subtype remains an error regardless of a raw flag. Cost stays null when not reported.

title: Require result and done
explanation: The parser handles fragmented UTF-8, CRLF, multiline data and bounded frames. The history cap is independent of final result processing.

title: Render safe colored Markdown
text: Color code and sanitize answer HTML.
explanation: Highlight.js supports C#, Python and TypeScript snippets. DOMPurify removes active content before Angular HTML insertion; unknown languages are escaped.

title: Complete result plus done
text: Send done only after SDK completion.
explanation: The same stream reaches Angular through .NET. Completion does not override a failed SDK result.

title: Send safe stream failure
text: Emit a safe error without done.
explanation: Provider diagnostics remain private. Deadline or disconnection cancellation closes the SDK iterator and temporary runtime.

title: Show recoverable error
text: Show feedback and release the run lock.
explanation: Cancel aborts fetch; finally clears timers and releases controls. Lesson state stays available for inspection and retry.

title: Reject missing model key
text: Stop before creating an SDK run.
explanation: Only Python loads the model key from agent-service/.env. Missing keys return query503 or an SSE error without done through the gateway. Health reports presence, not provider access.
